spans.s:
r. 1st and 10th cls. (इ) कुबि (कुम्बति-कुम्बयति)
To cover, to hide, to clothe, to screen, &c.

m. (-रः)
The deity KUVERA: see कुवेर.

mfn. (-ब्जः-ब्जा-ब्जं)
Humpbacked, crooked.
m. (-ब्जः)
1 A tree, (Achyranthes aspera): see अपामार्ग.
2 A scymitar.
3 A sort of fish, (Bola cuja, HAM.)
E.
कु the earth, or कु ill, badly, and उज to be straight, affix अच्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Humpbacked.
m. (-कः)
An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa): see वारिकण्टक.
E.
क water, and उब्ज to be straight, affix अच्, and कन् added, or कुब्ज and कन् aff.

m. (कः)
A white mimosa.
E.
कुब्ज, and कण्टक a thorn.

n. (-ब्रं)
1 A forest.
2 A hole for sacrificial fire.
3 An earring.
4 A thread.
5 A cart.
E.
कुबि to hide, रक् Uṇādi aff.

m. (-ह्मः)
A degraded or contemptible Brahman, one who officiates for Śūdras.
E.
कु bad, ब्रह्मन् a Brahman, टच् affix; also retaining the final, कुब्रह्मन्.
